confidence_notes: Medium overall. Coffee, beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable because several 2026 Amsterdam sources agree; beer assumes a 0.5 L draught. Cocktail is weakest because sources conflict, so it is set near 2x the beer anchor. Hostel private and 1-star hotel lack direct July sources and are bounded estimates; the 3-star rests on a July guide estimate. EUR is converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, an approximate July 2026 level that is not verified. The RBA figure comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview; the F11.1 table was not opened, and the RBA rate was not used for the USD anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are Amsterdam-specific, based on search results covering cost-of-living indexes, city tourism guides, and hostel and hotel aggregator averages, converted from EUR at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR.
